title: Maps to Stack — Google Maps leads into GitHub via MCP connector
description: Scrape Google Maps and write results to GitHub via MCP connector.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: How many businesses to scrape. Keep small (3-5) for tests — Playwright + residential proxy is billed per compute unit.

githubConnector.title: GitHub connector
githubConnector.description: MCP connector to your GitHub account. Authorize it once in Apify Console → Settings → Integrations. The Actor only sees a connector ID.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: owner/repo to write into. The repository must already exist.

path.title: File path
path.description: Path of the JSON file to create or update in the repository

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: A residential proxy is required — Google Maps blocks datacenter IPs.
